# Distribution Kit

This folder contains the execution assets used to distribute `openapi/awesome-corporate-standards` from this repository.

## Contents
Base folder: `.github/distribution/`


- `payloads/awesome-standards.md` - PR-ready payload for `donbarbos/awesome-standards`
- `payloads/awesome-compliance-getprobo.md` - PR-ready payload for `getprobo/awesome-compliance`
- `payloads/awesome-compliance-theopenlane.md` - PR-ready payload for `theopenlane/awesome-compliance`
- `notes/external-comments.md` - short rules for contextual posting outside GitHub

## Operating rule

These assets exist to drive traffic and discoverability back to this repository.
They are prepared here, versioned here, and updated here.
